display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-02-D3-15 Production technologies for solar photovoltaics beyond the state-of-the-art (EUPI-PV Partnership) – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-02-D3-15 Production technologies for solar photovoltaics beyond the state-of-the-art (EUPI-PV Partnership)
executive_summary: A Horizon Europe Innovation Action under the European Partnership for Innovation in Photovoltaics (EUPI-PV) that funds the demonstration of solar cells and modules with above-market conversion efficiency, a multi-MWp-ready, defect-free production technology, and digitalised, automated production equipment and pilot lines, reaching TRL 7. Any legal entity eligible under the standard Horizon Europe rules may take part, except entities controlled from China. The topic budget is EUR 36 million, around EUR 12 million per project for about three projects. The call opens on 3 December 2026 and the single-stage deadline is 31 March 2027, 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: The Climate, Energy and Mobility Work Programme 2026-2027 (Part 8), pp. 151–152, Specific conditions, Expected Outcome and Scope, funds new production technologies, equipment and pilot lines for solar PV cells and modules to rebuild European PV manufacturing. No project file is close: the 2GW Program concerns HVDC equipment supply, not PV manufacturing, and the topic addresses neither grid integration nor grid equipment, so it does not touch TenneT's field and is Not relevant.
